items.reason: The question directly asks about the woman’s complaint, and the passage supports the expected answer that the other woman hid her son.
“When the man of God prays” clearly identifies the event; the passage explicitly says the king’s hand was restored.
The supplied passage identifies the person only as “神人”; it does not support the identifying detail “从犹大来的” in the expected option.
“是为了什么结果” is unnatural phrasing that makes the respondent mentally reformulate the question. The intended connection to “愿神也听你们的话” can be retained.
The actor-action question is direct, and verse 17 explicitly identifies “那五个窥探地的人” as taking the listed objects.
“这三十万七千五百训练有素的军队” is an unnecessarily heavy numerical setup and awkwardly attaches a count of soldiers to “军队.” The intended leadership target is supported.
“After the man of God leaves” does not specify which departure: he leaves Bethel and later leaves the prophet’s house. The intended event after the latter departure needs a clear anchor.
“最先” leaves the comparison interval unstated. The passage describes both the five men taking the objects and the priest subsequently taking some, so the intended sequence needs clearer framing.
The question directly asks who handed over the weapons, and the passage clearly identifies the priest Jehoiada.
The causal question is direct, and “由于保罗第二天准备离开” explicitly supports option A.
